Priya / team — attaching the requested artifacts and a concise technical reply so we can meet MediSys' 07/23 turnaround: 

Attachments (attached to this message):
• redwood_onprem_network_diagram_v1.png — two variants: VPC private deployment and an on‑prem air‑gapped topology. Diagram includes flows for admin updates (manual media or secure jump host) and notes on outbound block lists.
• SOC2-CTA-summary.pdf — short note with issued date: 2026-03-15 (Type II) and scope: covers Redwood hosted API and Dedicated control plane; Private deployments are covered under our customer‑managed control plane appendix (controls that apply depend on deployment mode — see appendix A). Full report available under NDA.

Key technical answers (tl;dr):
1) KMS/HSM: We support customer‑managed keys in Private and Dedicated modes via AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, and on‑prem HSM (PKCS#11). For air‑gapped installs, HSM via LAN‑attached FIPS 140‑2/3 modules is supported.
2) Air‑gap: On‑prem package can be installed in an isolated network with zero egress. Updates are applied via signed artifacts delivered on removable media or via an inbound-only secure bastion that MediSys controls. We provide an update checklist and verification steps (hash checks, signed manifests).
3) Data flows: KV cache and model weights are stored on customer storage in Private installs; telemetry can be disabled. We recommend explicit network ACLs and host‑level mandatory access controls for additional assurance.
4) Timeline: We can produce completed questionnaire answers + artifacts by 07/23 EOD; full SOC 2 report will require an NDA/secure upload.

I will be on the Wed 07/21 10:00 PT sync to walk the diagram. Vivek — any commercial notes you want me to flag before we send the packet?
